provenance.native_route: four independent V20 public ObjectStroke::SetColor -> Drawing::drawObjectStroke -> Pen::SetColor -> PenDrawableRT::SetPenData captures; native RT Init/Update/Draw; no shader uniform overwrite.
provenance.native_frame_renderer: Mesa llvmpipe from native captures; target 256x256 RGBA8; full native frame readback SHA and top-down SHA recorded per ARGB.
provenance.native_geometry_semantics: Four little-endian five-f32 AddPoint records regenerated by the existing Rust ColoredPencil GLV4 sampler; all color captures independently report the same 80-byte geometry SHA.
provenance.raster_source_model: RGBA8 atlas uses the observed lowp sampler conversion (normalized R8 -> binary16 RTZ -> f32 alpha math). RGB is native inputColor.xyz. The source alpha byte is quantized after f32*255 using nearest-even as the current llvmpipe host-mode hypothesis; active IR does not record MXCSR, so the opaque control is the decisive rounding oracle.
provenance.svg_source: V28 exact clipped-wrapper atlas carrier; every case keeps full padded atlas, row orientation, nearest sampler CSS and source rect clips; only public ARGB affects PNG RGB and alpha.

binary.encoding: case entries are x:u16le,y:u16le,premultiplied native RGBA8; transparent pixels are implicit zero.
